metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete: ~3,360 lines across 11 files in `output/`, no external dependencies. All four canonical BibTeX styles (`plain`, `alpha`, `unsrt`, `abbrv`) produce well-formed `.bbl` files; the structured JSON log records the spec-defined counters and warning kinds; error JSON is emitted on parse/runtime failures with proper exit codes (0/1/2).

Key components:
- `main.py` — CLI with `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log`
- `bib.py` — `.bib` parser with `@string`/`@preamble`/`@comment`, crossref inheritance and cycle detection
- `bst.py` — `.bst` tokenizer/parser into commands and ops
- `interp.py` — stack interpreter with all 37 built-ins, ENTRY/STRINGS/INTEGERS/FUNCTION/MACRO/READ/EXECUTE/ITERATE/REVERSE/SORT
- `names.py` — name decomposition (Form 1/2/3) and `format.name$` with §10270-faithful inter-token rule
- `strings.py` — `purify$`, `change.case$` (title/upper/lower with `:` sentinel), `text.length$`, `text.prefix$`, `substring$`, `add.period$`
- `widths.py` — exact cmr10 character-width table from `bibtex.web` §13 plus the special-CS table for `\AE`/`\OE`/`\ss` etc.
- `buffer.py` — 79-column line wrapping with backward + forward-scan fallback and 2-space continuation indent
- `cites.py` — plain cite-list and `.aux` `\citation{}` extractor (also handles `*` for "all entries")
- `warnings.py` — Warning collection and `ParseError`/`RuntimeError_` exceptions

editorial.last_message:
The implementation is complete: ~3,360 lines across 11 files in `output/`, no external dependencies. All four canonical BibTeX styles (`plain`, `alpha`, `unsrt`, `abbrv`) produce well-formed `.bbl` files; the structured JSON log records the spec-defined counters and warning kinds; error JSON is emitted on parse/runtime failures with proper exit codes (0/1/2).

Key components:
- `main.py` — CLI with `--bib`, `--style`, `--cites`, `--aux`, `--output`, `--log`
- `bib.py` — `.bib` parser with `@string`/`@preamble`/`@comment`, crossref inheritance and cycle detection
- `bst.py` — `.bst` tokenizer/parser into commands and ops
- `interp.py` — stack interpreter with all 37 built-ins, ENTRY/STRINGS/INTEGERS/FUNCTION/MACRO/READ/EXECUTE/ITERATE/REVERSE/SORT
- `names.py` — name decomposition (Form 1/2/3) and `format.name$` with §10270-faithful inter-token rule
- `strings.py` — `purify$`, `change.case$` (title/upper/lower with `:` sentinel), `text.length$`, `text.prefix$`, `substring$`, `add.period$`
- `widths.py` — exact cmr10 character-width table from `bibtex.web` §13 plus the special-CS table for `\AE`/`\OE`/`\ss` etc.
- `buffer.py` — 79-column line wrapping with backward + forward-scan fallback and 2-space continuation indent
- `cites.py` — plain cite-list and `.aux` `\citation{}` extractor (also handles `*` for "all entries")
- `warnings.py` — Warning collection and `ParseError`/`RuntimeError_` exceptions
